_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Screen capture is kept after destination failure until the user cancels. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". The recording shortcuts are press_key "M" on whatever has focus, with modifiers "Control+Shift" for "the record-audio shortcut" and "Control+Alt+Shift" for "the record-screen shortcut". Press them on whatever has focus: do not click or focus anything for them. Draft creations fail with "draft unavailable"; call "draftText" returns the "draft" field of the last draft creation's JSON body ("none" before there is one). The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new and wait up to 30s for the message input to be visible. Fill it with "Do not lose this failed recording draft.".
2. Press the record-screen shortcut.
3. Call "draftText" should return "Do not lose this failed recording draft.".
4. [data-testid="recording-error"] should come to contain "draft unavailable", and the recording state should be "recording".
5. window.__recordingMock.stoppedTracks must be 0.
6. Click the cancel button. The message input should have the value "Do not lose this failed recording draft." and be enabled.
7. window.__recordingMock.stoppedTracks should become at least 2 (eval "window.__recordingMock.stoppedTracks >= 2" should become true).
8. Eval "(m => ({display: m.displayRequests, synchronousDisplay: m.synchronousDisplayRequests}))(window.__recordingMock)" must return exactly {"display":1,"synchronousDisplay":1}.
